story_title: Liquid Network Restores Bitcoin Backing After 4,000 BTC Exploit, but Withdrawals Remain Restricted

evidence.claim: The Liquid Federation announced full 1:1 L-BTC backing November 3, 2026
About 4,000 L-BTC were invalidly created and roughly 4,000 BTC withdrawn September 6; reserves fell about 4205 to 197 BTC
SideSwap reports 4270.54 BTC backing 4270.54 L-BTC on the morning of November 3 and continuing Federation peg-out restrictions
Samson Mow attributed reserve replacement to Blockstream; federation has not provided a full provenance breakdown
